html:
Fair and Affordable Unsecured Loans

Loans by MAL offer loans from £1,000 – £5,000 over terms up to 36 months. APR from 22.0% to 93.8%

Applicants must be aged 21-72, earn at least £1,300 per month, and reside in the UK.

Apply now

Representative Example: on an assumed loan amount of £2,500 over a 24 month repayment period. Rate of interest 24.1% per annum (fixed). Representative 49.6% APR. Total amount payable is £3,705.12 of which £1,205.12 is interest, 24 monthly repayments of £154.38.

QUICK & EASY APPLICATION PROCESS – WITH FAST IN-PRINCIPLE DECISION

Important Note

Late repayments can lead to serious money problems. For debt counselling advice please visit moneyadviceservice.org.uk

Eligibility Criteria

Age

You'll need to be aged between 21 & 71 years old at the time of application.

UK Residency

You must live and work in the UK on a permanent basis.

Income

You'll need to earn a minimum of £1,300 per month after tax from employment, self-employment or pensions.

UK Bank Account

You'll need a UK bank account that supports Open Banking connections.

Why Choose Loans by MAL?

  • Loans available from 22.0% APR*
  • Quick approval process
  • Direct Lender, not a broker
  • All online - no documents required
  • Rated 'Excellent' on Trustpilot
  • 37,500 Customers Helped

*Subject to status. Terms & Conditions Apply

Read more

Unsecured Loans up to £5,000

Loans by MAL is a direct lender offering unsecured loans from £1,000 to £5,000, over terms of 9 to 36 months.

We lend to a wide range of customers, using a combination of credit file and open banking data to make responsible and personalised lending decisions.

By using Open Banking technology, we can often help customers who are unable to borrow from banks and other lenders.

To check your eligibility and get your personalised loan offer, complete the first two steps of our online application. Doing so won’t impact your credit score.

If you still have questions, why not check out our FAQs.
